scripts.start: npm run build:happ && AGENTS=2 npm run network
scripts.spin: npm run build:happ && AGENTS=2 npm run spin-network
scripts.network: BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run launch"
scripts.spin-network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=1420 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run spin:happ"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm t -w tests
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.network:android: npm run build:happ && BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run tauri android dev" "npm run tauri dev"
scripts.start:android:holochain_bundled: npm run build:happ && BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run tauri:android:dev:holochain_bundled"
scripts.start:android:holochain_service: npm run build:happ && BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run tauri:android:dev:holochain_sevice"
scripts.start:desktop: cp -f src-tauri/tauri.desktop.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && npm run build:happ && BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run tauri dev -- --features holochain_bundled"
scripts.start:desktop:happ-release: npm run setup:happ-release && concurrently -k "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run tauri dev -- --release --features holochain_bundled"
scripts.tauri:android:dev:holochain_bundled: cp -Rf src-tauri/gen/android-holochain_bundled/* src-tauri/gen/android/ && cp -f src-tauri/tauri.mobile.holochain_bundled.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && npm run tauri android dev -- --features holochain_bundled
scripts.tauri:android:dev:holochain_service: cp -Rf src-tauri/gen/android-holochain_service/* src-tauri/gen/android/ && cp -f src-tauri/tauri.mobile.holochain_service.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && npm run tauri android dev -- --features holochain_service
scripts.tauri:android:build:holochain_bundled: cp -Rf src-tauri/gen/android-holochain_bundled/* src-tauri/gen/android/ && cp -f src-tauri/tauri.mobile.holochain_bundled.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && npm run tauri android build -- --features holochain_bundled
scripts.tauri:android:build:holochain_service: cp -Rf src-tauri/gen/android-holochain_service/* src-tauri/gen/android/ && cp -f src-tauri/tauri.mobile.holochain_service.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && npm run tauri android build -- --features holochain_service
